standard-dialogue-before-starting-family.npc: What? Can't you see I'm busy?

standard-dialogue-after-completing-famil.npc: I have received word from my father of your assistance to our family in this matter. You have my thanks for restoring our honour.
Yes well... Is there anything I can help you with?

options.text: Can you change my gauntlets for me?

steps.player: Can you change my gauntlets for me?

steps.npc: Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins.

steps.text: Avan takes your gauntlets, takes out a small hammer, and pounds them into a slightly new shape, then hands them back to you.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-famil.npc: I have received word from my father that you assisted us again! I get the feeling you weren't going to stop trying until you did though.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-famil.text: If this is the first time the player has talked to Avan after completing Family Pest:

steps.npc: As a token of my appreciation, I will happily forge you as many pairs of Goldsmith gauntlets as you desire.

steps.text: Avan hands you a pair of Goldsmith gauntlets.

steps.npc: You will find the rate you gain experience when smelting gold much improved whilst wearing these gauntlets.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-famil.text: If the player has already talked to Avan at least once after completing Family Pest:

options.text: Could I have some more goldsmith gauntlets, please?

steps.player: Could I have some more goldsmith gauntlets, please?

steps.text: How many would you like to take?
Avan hands you some goldsmith gauntlets.

steps.npc: You will find the rate you gain experience when smelting gold much improved whilst wearing these gauntlets.
